Resolved by the Gen4 release (2026-08-15)

The Gen4 release resolved the questions about the actual weight values, whether VMRanker and DPP are active, and the number of Phoenix heads. The training pipeline and cold start questions were resolved in part, with some remainder.

  • ✅ Actual weight values: home-mixer/params/param.rs was released as a production cron mirror.
  • ✅ Whether VMRanker/DPP are on: they are on (EnableVMRanker=true, DPP θ=0.65, K=150).
  • ✅ Number of Phoenix heads: confirmed as 24 per the documentation.
    • The composition is Engagement 7 + Clicks 6 + Attention 5 + Author 1 + Negative 5.
  • ✅ 2026 Rust training pipeline: phoenix/ has the training code, synthetic data, and a QUICKSTART. However, the loss, negative sampling, and optimizer need a deep dive.
  • ✅ Absence of new-item cold start: Gen4 released a new-author boost (PostUnexploredWeight=0.02, ColdStartImpressionThreshold=1000). However, there is still no separate mechanism for individual new posts.

Resolved by the Gen4+1 release (2026-08-16)

This release resolved the questions about the rule for reading weight ratios, the cold start slot selector, and the jurisdiction filter. The Phoenix bool features and the BDSM enforcement note were resolved only in part.

  • ✅ Rule for interpreting weight ratios: the comments in param.rs and ranking_scorer.rs and the README state explicitly "do not read the ratio as a raw count equivalent".
    • Through Gen3 the canon cited documents that interpreted this as "reply 13.5 = the value of 27 favorites". It is now confirmed that this interpretation was a framing that was wrong in principle.
  • ✅ Fill status of the Phoenix bool features: the observation that all of bool_features are zero-stamped was partly resolved in Gen4+1.
    • Three were filled (IS_STALE_POST14D and IS_AUTHOR_FOLLOWED/FOLLOWING).
    • Whether the remaining bool slots are used is still not public.
  • ✅ Cold start slot selector logic: two branches, greedy and Beta Thompson sampling, were connected through params. However, Thompson is off by default, and actual production is still greedy.
  • ✅ Existence of a jurisdiction filter: confirmed at the code level through Brazil2026ElectionFilter. Whether election and regulation responses for other countries will be attached by the same practice is a new checkpoint to watch.
  • ✅ BDSM enforcement note generation logic: the gate and dominant head logic were released. The template strings and the operating point values are still not public.

Resolved by the Gen4+2 release (2026-08-19)

This release revealed how Grok safety labels are migrated, how conflicting adult content verdicts are handled, and the indexing gate of Phoenix retrieval. The judgment on the first item was overturned the next day.

  • ✅ Schema migration practice for Grok safety labels: it was confirmed that the label schema is managed by version and that its migration is built into dual-write detection logic in the code. Caution: this judgment was overturned by a redesign in Gen4+3 (the next day)(Gen4+3 record).
    • compute_verdict_v2 references six _V2 labels.
    • strip_v1_grok_written filters out V1 dual-write labels that belong to PROMPT_OWNED_RULES = [1400, 1410, 1420, 1500, 1510, 1610, 1700].
    • The v2_mirrors_v1_across_tier_matrix test asserts V1/V2 equivalence across 6 label combinations and 2 tweet_id points.
  • ✅ Handling when adult content verdicts conflict: when safemodel and PtOS disagree, the Grok 4.5 judge re-decides, and only hard→soft demotion is allowed.
    • safemodel is an in-house vision model, and PtOS is a policy verdict. There is no escalation.
    • The verdict layer expanded to three layers (safemodel, PtOS, the Grok 4.5 judge).
    • A dedicated circuit breaker for EAPI_GROK_4_5_X_ALGO was added, and the audit log states the text "Grok 4.5 Cross Validation disagreed" explicitly.
  • ✅ Indexing gate of Phoenix retrieval: the favoriteCount >= 1 condition was removed from build1FavIndex and buildMMEmbMetadataDump. The actual index is all incoming candidates.
    • The index name "1fav" became a backward compat label.
    • The 1fav_uec_count_race counter instruments only the cases reached without a fav.
  • Deep dive needed (new):
    • Whether the Grok 4.5 judge expands to other categories
    • The actual observed rate of 1fav_uec_count_race (not observable from outside)

Resolved or overturned by the Gen4+3 release (2026-08-20)

This release overturned the dual-write judgment on brand safety V2 that was considered settled in Gen4+2 the day before. It also confirmed the SID connection in VMRanker, the hydration branch between For You and Following, the move of the Phoenix event stream to v3, and the merge of the grox reply_spam flow.

  • ⚠ Claim changed (in one day): the V2 brand safety dual-write logic was completely redesigned.
    • The Gen4+2 approach was strip_v1_grok_written and seven PROMPT_OWNED_RULES rule ids. The Gen4+3 approach is four V2_WRITTEN_LABELS gates and V1 fallback semantics.
    • The seven PROMPT_OWNED_RULES disappeared from the code entirely. The deep-dive item that asked about their rule id mapping was resolved automatically (the question itself no longer exists).
    • The new semantics are much cleaner: "if even one V2 label exists, V2 decides and V1 heuristics are ignored entirely; if none exists, fall back to V1".
    • This case is strong evidence for the observation that X exposes the reality of "daily commit" dual-write migrations as they are.
  • ✅ SID connection in VMRanker: seven SID fields entered the VMRanker request. We confirmed that there is a re-ranking-side SID consumer that pairs with the SID window in Phoenix retrieval.
    • The fields are sid_known, sid_k_l1/2/3, and sid_gap_l1/2/3.
    • The architectural fact that SID is a 3-level hierarchical codebook was newly revealed.
  • ✅ Hydration branch between For You and Following: For You and Following started to split explicitly at the pipeline stage.
    • VFFollowingCandidateHydrator was newly connected.
    • Following now keeps only the VF result and leaves the other candidate fields at default.
  • ✅ The Phoenix event stream moved to v3 and the Kafka cluster was separated.
    • content_understanding_realtime_unified_posts → ..._v3
    • main-2 → phoenix-kafka-external-bootstrap
    • ValueOnly → KeyValue(key=Long)
    • grox reply_spam also moved to v3 in the same commit, and its flow was unified.
  • ✅ The grox reply_spam flow was unified and its threshold was adjusted again.
    • PostStreamTaskGenerator was deleted, and ReplyRankingTaskGenerator absorbed PlanSpamComment and PlanCoordinatedSpam.
    • The follower threshold rose from 40k to 60k. This is the third increase, after 30k → 40k in the 2026-08-17 commit (Gen4+2).
  • Deep dive needed (new):
    • The origin of the four V2_WRITTEN_LABELS labels (a Grok prompt change? retraining?)
    • The SID codebook definition (vocabulary size and training approach of each level)
    • The formula for sid_gap
    • Whether Phoenix Kafka unified_posts_v2 existed (or whether it was a direct jump from v1 to v3)
    • How the ColdStartTrackedIds param actually connects to the simplified count_tracked_ids instrumentation

Resolved or new in the Gen4+4 release (2026-08-21)

This release confirmed the Phoenix optimizer in code and gave the first signal that Phoenix is expanding to the search surface. It also newly revealed the reward head and distribution prediction head, a Following-side filter, the PTOS Grok 4.6 shadow, and the VF shadow deployment base.

  • ✅ The identity of the Phoenix dense-param optimizer was confirmed in code in Gen4+4. This long-undisclosed item is a hybrid of Muon (Newton-Schulz orthogonalization) and Adam.
    • muon_adam_patterns="embed,_emb,logits,vocab,norm,table"
    • base LR 1e-3 → 7.1e-4, muon_split_fused="qkv:128", muon_consistent_rms=0.2
    • Embeddings use rowwise_adagrad (LR 0.28, half-life 2500 step, lazy_decay, weight_decay 2.8e-4).
    • The GB300 override is LR 5e-4 and half-life 5000.
    • This is the first case, among the large-scale production recsys training pipelines this repository has covered, where Muon adoption is confirmed in code. A new axis of observation opened: LLM optimizers moving into ranker/retrieval training.
  • ✅ The first code signal appeared that Phoenix is expanding to the search surface. A search config was newly added, paired with the two proto actions CLIENT_TWEET_(NOT_)RELEVANT_TO_SEARCH.
    • The config is xrecsys_search (vocab 100M/100M/30M, EP 512, use_product_surface=True, condition_search_relevance_on_prompt=True).
    • The earlier canon understood each surface to have its own codebase. Now the same Phoenix Transformer is being unified so that swapping only the config serves both search and feed.
  • ✅ The skeleton of a reward head appeared in the Phoenix proto. A connection toward RL (actor-critic value+policy) training or reward-model-guided re-ranking slate decisions has begun. Which scorer consumes it needs a deep dive.
    • The new items are RewardOutputs (values and policyLogits) and ScoreInfo.rewardRerankSlotProb.
    • The 2026-10-14 commit 17c96bf (Gen4+41) released the page decoder (actor) and twin critic training code for the immersive surface, and this training reads the rewardRerankSlotProbSeq column as the logged probability rl_rerank_prob verified (Gen4+41 in the change log).
      • In the same commit, code outside the proto does not reference RewardOutputs (rewardOutputs and policyLogits) verified — grep over all of 17c96bf.
  • ✅ The prediction schema of X's ranker began to carry a distribution shape for the first time. It predicts link-open probability not as a single scalar but with five quantile heads: P10/P25/P50/P75/P90.
  • ✅ The parallel structure of the Following pipeline widened. After the hydrator branch in Gen4+3, one filter and one hydrator were newly attached in Gen4+4.
    • The Gen4+3 branch is VFFollowingCandidateHydrator.
    • FollowingViewerMutedKeywordFilter (65 lines) also matches quoted text and ancestors.
    • QuotedPostTextHydrator (106 lines) fetches the quoted text from TES.
    • For You and Following use different components in their filter and hydrator stacks, so the parallel structure is reconfirmed.
  • ✅ A Grok 4.6 shadow started in the PTOS verdict layer. Only 10% of traffic goes to 4.6 in the child safety cross-validation and deluxe 4.3 categories. The dual-write stage of the 4.5 → 4.6 gradual rollout has begun.
    • The ratio is set by _GROK_4_6_INTERNAL_DIAL = 0.1.
    • The new model (EAPI_GROK_4_6_INTERNAL) and a dedicated circuit breaker were connected.
    • prior_nsfw.py (34 new lines) separates the Manhattan lookup cache.
  • ✅ The VF shadow deployment infrastructure was connected. A base for verifying rule changes of the fail-closed VF through shadow was established (Gen4+4 in the change log).
    • visibility-filtering/dark_traffic_setup.rs (109 new lines) is env-gated and mirrors requests to xai-vf-shadow.prod.visibility only from specific ordinal pods.
    • It uses mTLS and reloads the /config/dark-traffic/dark_traffic.yaml rule file.
  • ✅ The three Phoenix bool features filled in Gen4+1 were raised to ON by default in training.
    • The four enable_stale_post, enable_is_author_followed_by_viewer, enable_is_author_following_viewer, and enable_engagement_counts are the defaults of _home_direct_packed_base().
    • Only the grpc_recsys dataset type overrides enable_stale_post=False (presumably to avoid the count zeroing risk in real-time serving inferred).
  • Deep dive needed (new):
    • In which training loop RewardOutputs is filled and which scorer consumes it (the large +265/−25 overhaul of recsys_model.py must be traced)
    • Whether the link-open 5-quantile is a quantile regression or a categorical mixture
    • Whether the xrecsys_search config was deployed to production
    • Observed performance of Muon (no public metrics)
    • The actual dark_traffic YAML (undisclosed)
    • The prompt form of condition_search_relevance_on_prompt

Resolved or new in the Gen4+5 release (2026-08-22)

This release connected the path by which home-mixer receives and uses the slate context built by Phoenix serving (the gate is false by default). AI trend context began to attach to For You candidates. The Grok 4.6 shadow ratio tripled in one day.

  • ✅ A path appeared that consumes the slate context built by Phoenix serving. SlateContext.sid*, introduced in the proto in Gen4+4, was connected through to the actual pipeline. The gate was connected as false by default.
    • The components are PostCandidate.served_slate_context, the From<xai_recsys_proto::SlateContext> conversion impl, the candidate_slate_context() extraction in PhoenixScorer, and the three-way fallback in RankingScorer.
    • The fallback order is the UseServedSlateContext gate first → cache → local computation.
    • The first step is confirmed in moving the slate context computation point from home-mixer local to Phoenix serving.
  • ✅ A new AI trend feedback context channel appeared. An "AI trend" label is attached to For You candidates as a second context channel alongside topic feedback. It enters as a fallback only when there is no topic feedback, so the two do not overlap.
    • TOP_TREND_COUNT = 2 (at most 2 per page).
    • One candidate is picked at random per trend.
    • A triple gate applies: standalone original post, non-topic, non-in-network.
    • The landing URL is https://x.com/i/trending/{trend_id}.
  • ✅ The core of the emb_table loader was split out as pyo3-free. This prepares large embedding tables to be loaded in non-Python contexts. The direction matches the vocab 100M/100M/30M flow of xrecsys_search.
    • The core is load_tensor_into(&str, &str, &[(String, String, usize, usize)], &mut [u8], usize, usize) -> Result<(), String>, and the Python wrapper is separate.
  • ✅ The Grok 4.6 traffic split dial rose 3× in one day, from 10% to 30%. This supports that the 4.6 traffic stayed within the acceptable disagreement rate range without a circuit breaker trip inferred. The flow of daily refinement continues through Gen4+2→+3→+4→+5.
  • ✅ A callback to end streaming responses early was added to grok_sampler. This is a sampling infrastructure optimization matched to the growth of 4.6 traffic inferred.
    • stop_predicate and aclosing were connected, and the llm.sample.early_stop.count counter was added.
  • ✅ A profile_image field was newly added to the grox User. The schema was extended so the Grok classifier can reference the profile image as verdict context.
  • Deep dive needed (new):
    • The upstream definition of AI trend (Grok clustering? human curation?) and the pipeline source of batch_get_tweet_ai_trend
    • When the UseServedSlateContext gate is raised to true. That point is also when the Phoenix-served slate context reaches production traffic (the checkpoint to watch in the next commit).
    • The next move of the Grok 4.6 dial (30% → 50%/100% or a decrease)
    • Where stop_predicate is actually used (whether it serves as a callback matching the safety verdict JSON tag)

Resolved by the Gen4+6 release / new (2026-08-23)

This release added 20 ads conversion prediction heads and a delayed-feedback training branch, and the export nano config now inherits the training recipe of the GB300 override. PTOS child-safety cross-validation and deluxe reclassification moved entirely to Grok 4.6 internal.

  • ✅ 20 new ads conversion prediction heads were added. Previously only app installs were predicted; now six post-install engagement events are predicted for click and view each (ads conversion subsection).
    • They were added at proto ActionName 171–190. They are 6 MACT in-app events (purchase·add_to_cart·level_achieved·tutorial_complete·sign_up·custom) × 2 families click/view = 12, plus 8 view-through conversions (web conversions).
    • Previously there was only ADS_ATTRIBUTED_MACT_CLICK_INSTALL (=140).
    • CLIENT_TWEET_SEARCH_QUERY_REFORMULATED was added to NEGATIVE_FEEDBACK_HEAD_INDICES.
  • ✅ The training loss now splits on whether feedback is delayed. X ranker training is now explicitly aligned with the standard handling in the ads delayed conversion prediction literature (Chapelle 2014).
    • The split_head_training_by_source config brings kafka's is_delayed_feedback column in as sample_source.
    • Engagement heads train only on fresh samples and conversion heads only on delayed samples (the loss mask splits).
    • There are three metric slices: fresh/delayed_clicked/delayed_non_clicked.
    • The tuning knobs are mact_in_app_loss_weight, train_view_through_heads, and conversion_keep_mask.
  • ✅ A new ads_slim metric group was added. It is a slim signal combination for the ads ranking line.
    • It includes 3 positive signals (open link, external link long dwell, video quality view).
    • It includes 4 negative signals (not interested, block, report, mute).
    • Non-primary conversion clicks are also included.
  • ✅ The Muon training recipe was formally added to the export. The export moved to a state where running the exported training Python code as is yields production Muon training.
    • TRAINING.md, README, and reference/README.md were rewritten. They state explicitly that the flagship ranking config and home_direct_packed_nano are trained end-to-end with the production Muon recipe.
    • Embedding rowwise AdaGrad has three options: accumulator half-life decay, lazy per-row decay, and decoupled weight decay.
  • ✅ home_direct_packed_nano now inherits the LR and optimizer settings of the NVIDIA GB300 hardware override. The override itself has existed since the Gen4 release verified — xrecsys.py:305-313. The same file has also had _H100_OVERRIDES since the Gen4 release (line 297 of the same file).
    • _GB300_OVERRIDES defines bs_per_device=512, ep=64, attn_impl="cutedsl_ranker_varlen_attn", remat_policy=RematType.SAVE_GB300_RECSYS, unroll_layer_stack=True, LR 5e-4, and checkpoint_every_n=300.
    • This attention kernel is a varlen attention kernel based on NVIDIA CUTLASS/CUTe DSL, and may be an xAI in-house kernel.
  • ✅ It was confirmed for the first time that an xai-o2 storage system exists inside xAI. The interface of the xai-o2 crate, an S3-compatible object storage client, was released.
    • It exposes a BaseO2Client trait and 15 builder methods (endpoint, bucket, access_key, chunk_size_mib, retry, timeout, etc.).
    • However, build() always returns the error "the xai-o2 backend is not included in this build" in open-source builds.
  • ✅ Grok 4.5 internal was removed entirely from PTOS child-safety cross-validation and deluxe reclassification, and 4.6 internal went to 100%. The dial-up (10%→30%→100%) that began in the 2026-08-19 commit (Gen4+4) finished in two days verified — aad7179, d0cef2f, classifier.py in 28e414f.
    • The adult-content judge (Gen4+2) keeps using EAPI_GROK_4_5_X_ALGO regardless of this dial verified — classifier.py:563.
    • All 4.5-related breaker, sampler, and dial constants were deleted. Rollback is not possible.
  • ✅ SlateContext was added as field #9 of NextActionDistribution. Now a slate context is attached to each action distribution as well. The consumption path is still a skeleton.
    • Earlier, Gen4+4 introduced ScoreInfo.slateContext (re-ranking slate decisions) and Gen4+5 introduced PostCandidate.served_slate_context (consumed by home-mixer).
  • ✅ The grox reply_spam follower threshold rose from 60k to 80k. It is the fourth increase within 8 days of the Gen4 release (15k→30k→40k→60k→80k), and this increase is 1.33×.
  • ✅ The visibility-filtering dark_traffic target changed from shadow to staging. ⚠ The Gen4+4 canon interpretation needs to be revisited (Gen4+4 in the change log).
    • Within 3 days the shadow workload was deleted and redefined as staging mirroring.
    • The target changed from xai-vf-shadow.prod.visibility to xai-vf-service.staging.visibility:grpc.
  • Deep dive needed (new):
    • The source of the is_delayed_feedback upstream pipeline (the conversion re-observation event logger that feeds this column into kafka)
    • When split_head_training_by_source is promoted to True in _home_direct_packed_base() or the flagship config (a signal that ads conversion training is moving to production)
    • When the train_view_through_heads opt-in is promoted
    • Whether the flagship also explicitly inherits the GB300 override
    • Whether the actual xai-o2 implementation will be released (unlikely inferred)
    • Which way the EVERGREEN retrieval dataset is redefined (rename vs. revert)
    • When 4.7 shadow starts after Grok 4.6 settles
    • Whether the cutedsl_ranker_varlen_attn kernel is an xAI in-house kernel

Resolved by the Gen4+7 release / new (2026-08-26)

This release added a regression verification channel that measures the consistency of the visibility filtering rewrite, and brand safety verdicts grew to four levels. The PTOS judge widened to three categories.

  • ✅ The regression verification channel for the VF rewrite is connected. The consistency of the VF sub-repo rewrite, the Gen4 headline, can now be audited at production traffic scale. Rollout risk dropped considerably (Gen4+7 in the change log).
    • visibility-filtering/reference_compare.rs (812 lines, new) is layered on top of the dark_traffic stack (Gen4+4/+6), making it possible to measure actual verdict comparison.
    • It is staging-only, through VF_DUAL_CALL_HARNESS_ENABLED and an enforcement mechanism that panics when APP_ENV=prod.
  • ✅ BrandSafetyVerdict grew to four levels. Previously the brand safety verdict controlled ads adjacency with only three levels (Safe/Low/Medium), and lumped labels of different risk into the same tier. This limitation is resolved.
    • The new tier is HighRisk = 4.
    • The five labels that were in medium (NSFW_HIGH_PRECISION·NSFW_HIGH_RECALL·GORE_AND_VIOLENCE_HIGH_PRECISION·PDNA·EGREGIOUS_NSFW) and the new SOFT_NSFW were promoted to HighRisk. V1 and V2 moved symmetrically.
    • The ads utility has_avoid() handles both Medium and High, and the quote adjacency escalation also changed from Medium → High.
  • ✅ Five V2 labels are exposed in the downstream proto. Previously V2 labels existed only inside home-mixer. Now other services that consume the feed response can also see the V2 verdict.
    • GROK_SFA_V2, GROK_NSFA_LIMITED_V2, GROK_NSFA_V2, GROK_NSFA_EXPANDED_V2, and PTOS_REVIEWED were added to the safety_label_to_proto mapping in scored_posts_server.rs.
  • ✅ DDG tracking for the V2 experiment is connected. V2 is at the experiment stage, and the infrastructure to observe revenue/safety metrics is complete. The 8-day journey of Gen4+2 (introduction) → +3 (redesign) → +7 (experiment measurement) is complete.
    • ads_injection_logging_side_effect.rs logs the EnableAdsBrandSafetyVerdictV2 experiment bucket in the ddg_experiment_bucket field.
  • ✅ The PTOS judge layer widened to 3 categories. Previously there was an adult-content judge class and, separately, the child-safety cross-model validation that had been inside the classifier since the Gen4 release. Now all 3, ChildSafety, ViolentMedia, and IllegalAndRegulatedBehaviors, are grouped into one judge class (Grox → PtOS section).
    • The new judge is SafetyPtosPolicyCrossValidator. The earlier adult-content judge is SafetyPtosAdultContentCrossValidationJudge (Gen4+2).
    • The new judge class uses the EAPI_GROK_4_5_X_ALGO endpoint that the adult-content judge has used since Gen4+2. It is separate from EAPI_GROK_4_5_INTERNAL, which was removed entirely in Gen4+6 verified — classifier.py:100, 561.
    • X has settled into a dual stack that keeps the primary (4.6) and the judge (4.5 X_ALGO) on different models and tuning.
  • ✅ Parent-thread rendering was turned on for the PTOS ViolentSpeech and SuicideOrSelfHarm categories. Now grox puts the post and its ancestors into the LLM prompt together.
    • The underlying reason is that these two categories cannot be judged for harm from the target post's text alone.
      • For example, whether "I want to die" is about a game or about self-harm is decided only by the thread context.
    • USE_THREAD_RENDERER_CATEGORIES is new.
    • USE_REASONING_CATEGORIES was also turned on for only these two (thinking suppression lifted).
  • ✅ The Phoenix checkpoint loader was reinforced for multi-node environments. It addresses restore-path OOM issues on the Muon and GB300 generation (checkpoint stack subsection).
    • It is a follow-up verification result that came after Gen4+6 formally included flagship Muon training in the export inferred.
    • xai_checkpointing/load.py gained new arguments domains (per-tensor slice), tag (checkpoint subdir), and concurrent_gb (concurrent decoding throttle).
    • Restore is serialized per node with XAI_RESTORE_NODE_SERIALIZE and fcntl.flock().
  • ✅ grox reply_spam started writing reply ranking scores to the regional cache as well. The path that writes scores back to Strato has existed since the Gen4 release, and this time regional cache fanout was added verified — storage module in d011592.
    • ReplyRankingScoreStratoLoader has put scores to Strato and emitted them to Kafka v2 since the Gen4 release (47c1bcd).
    • Since Gen4+7, when score ≤ 1.0 it also fans out to the regional caches (Atla, Pdxa).
  • ✅ The grox reply_spam follower threshold rose from 80k to 100k. It rose five times in 11 days (15k→30k→40k→60k→80k→100k), so the set of spam-judgment targets keeps widening.
  • ✅ X Spaces (audio) context enters the grox LLM judgment. The audio itself is not listened to, but the Space title becomes material for brand safety and adult content judgments.
    • The SpaceMetadata class and the Post.space_metadata field are new.
    • The renderer puts the audio Space card into the prompt in the form \n\nThis post has the following audio space card attached:\nAudio Space title: {title}.
  • Deep dive needed (new):
    • Whether the VF reference diff goes only to logs or to a separate dashboard (definition of the promotion threshold: "promote if the diff rate is X% or lower")
    • What the reference VF wrapped by StratoVfClient actually is (a remnant of the Gen1 and Gen2 Scala VF? a separate stack?)
    • Whether the HighRisk tier triggers follow-up actions beyond ads avoid (strong ranker decay, complete block of organic impressions)
    • The holdout/treatment ratio of the V2 experiment
    • How EAPI_GROK_4_5_X_ALGO is tuned (x-algorithm fine-tuning on the 4.5 base, or a completely separate model)
    • The next category for PTOS judge expansion (spam and hate speech are presumably the next targets of the sequential expansion inferred)
    • Whether SafetyPtosAdultContentCrossValidationJudge and the new SafetyPtosPolicyCrossValidator will be unified (same function signature, different routing)
    • The meaning of the grox reply_spam score threshold 1.0 (whether the cache fanout gating threshold is a probability or a score)
    • Whether a pipeline exists in which the LLM listens to the audio content itself (Space title text only vs. STT of the real audio stream)
    • The production tuning value of concurrent_gb and how much restore time increases

Resolved by the Gen4+8 release / new (2026-08-27)

This release added a general path for the abuse-enforcement service to execute actions requested by scorers. The VMRanker path was greatly simplified, and the Following pipeline now applies block relationships up to the original author of quote and retweet chains.

  • ✅ A general pipeline in which AES executes actions requested by scorers is connected. Now a scorer can add and send requested_actions directly, outside the hardcoded YAML rules (Gen4+8 in the change log).
    • The new file is abuse-enforcement-service/service-lib/src/generic_actions.rs (663 lines, new), and its rule pair is the platform_row_without_requested_actions skip and the act_requested_actions act.
    • Verification is two layers of fail-closed.
      • (a) hardcoded kind allowlist (5 user kinds, 2 post kinds, MAX 16 per msg)
      • (b) GrowthBook dynamic allowlist (kinds·suspend_policies·labels)
    • Rejected requests are not discarded but are recorded as outcome.info["requested_actions_skipped"] JSON and the GENERIC_ACTION_TOTAL{outcome=skipped, reason} metric.
    • As the first client, the panda_reports_embedding_v10_rough_spam label appeared in a temporary PlatformManipulation suspend rule. This is evidence that the embedding-based spam detector is a continuous pipeline retrained up to v10.
  • ✅ The VMRanker path was greatly simplified. VMRanker passes through the score returned by the rank server as is, and DPP diversity is handled by the server's own logic.
    • AUTHOR_DIVERSITY_VALUE_MODEL_ID, the 128-line MPN fallback, the AuthorColdStart post-processing, and the 88-line ranking_scorer::effective_head_weights were all deleted.
    • The only new constant is DPP_VALUE_MODEL_ID = "dpp".
    • It is an architecture refactor that pairs with Gen4+5's UseServedSlateContext (migrating slate context to Phoenix serving). home-mixer is kept thin and the gRPC servers take over the computation.
  • ✅ The Following pipeline respects block relationships up to the original author of quote/retweet chains. X explicitly blocks block circumvention through quotes/retweets.
    • The new hydrator FollowingBlockedByHydrator (65 lines) makes a batch check_blocked_by lookup to SocialGraphClient with the list of quoted/retweeted authors of each candidate.
    • AuthorSocialgraphFilter filters on six branches.
      • (i) viewer→author mute
      • (ii) viewer→author block
      • (iii) author→viewer block
      • (iv) quoted author→viewer block
      • (v) viewer→quoted author block
      • (vi) viewer→retweeted author block
    • It is connected in reverse_chron_posts_pipeline.rs (before the VF filter).
  • ✅ The account list of Brazil2026ElectionFilter was updated. This is a sign that a regular update practice has taken hold. The filter semantics did not change (the follow exception is kept).
    • It reflects the TSE dadosabertos 2026-08-25 edition (+3,379 lines, 4,947 lines in the whole file).
    • The README also states it explicitly: "(Account list updated August 25, 2026.)".
  • ✅ A prefloor snapshot is connected in phoenix-rankall. New candidates stay in a separate pool until they pass the min_age threshold, and once they pass they are reflected in production immediately.
    • The changed files are store/base.rs (+202/−61) and config/mod.rs (+51/−12).
    • For windows with min_age, the prefloor_<window>.parquet file is loaded as well (PREFLOOR_SLACK_SECS = 6.0 * 3600.0, 6 hours of slack).
    • It is a freshness improvement in the same direction as the removal of the favoriteCount>=1 gate in Gen4+2.
  • ✅ The Phoenix copy_port rate limit became accurate. Previously, sequential polling could let actual in-flight concurrency exceed the cap. It is a serving-side reinforcement that pairs with Gen4+7's restore path reinforcement.
    • In copy_port_client.rs (+155), join_all(futures) changed to join_all(futures.map(tokio::task::spawn)).
    • Now the tokio scheduler runs them in true parallel, and the rate limit issues the next batch based on the in-flight count.
    • There are two regression tests (rate_limit_caps_in_flight_despite_spawn, rate_limit_paces_between_spawned_batches).
  • ✅ The README's Latest Updates was renamed Notable Updates. It is a declaration that the README will not be updated daily even though follow-up commits are added daily inferred.
  • ✅ In the home-mixer cron mirror (sync 2026-08-25), two weights and the ads brand safety V2 switch changed verified — home-mixer/params/param.rs:342, 356, 908.
    • VqvWeight changed from 0.05 to 0.0, and DwellWeight changed from 0.0 to 0.05.
    • EnableAdsBrandSafetyVerdictV2 changed from false to true. This value went back to false in the 2026-09-16 commit (Gen4+22) and became true again in the 2026-10-03 commit (Gen4+35).
  • Deep dive needed (new):
    • The first production GrowthBook configuration of the generic_actions allowlist (which scorers it opens to first)
    • The evolution of panda_reports_embedding_v10 from the earlier v1–v9 and when v11 arrives
    • The actual value model architecture of DPP_VALUE_MODEL_ID (whether it is the same as the DPP (θ=0.65, K=150) in the re-ranking section or different)
    • The new consumer point of AuthorColdStart (where it went after being removed from vm_ranker)
    • Whether AuthorSocialgraphFilter is also connected to the For You pipeline
    • The first active window of the prefloor snapshot
    • The role of the grox/flows/upa/ subflow
    • The new event type in the +27 lines of URT client_event.rs

Resolved by the Gen4+9 release / new (2026-08-28)

This release made both saving and restoring of Phoenix checkpoints batch pipelines, and unified the training-step validity gating between dense and embedding. VF removed the media fallback cache, and three ads conversion heads were newly added to the proto.

  • ✅ The Phoenix checkpoint stack was reorganized again so that both save and restore have an RSS cap. The entire Muon+GB300 checkpoint round trip is now a batched pipeline (checkpoint stack subsection).
    • Symmetric to Gen4+7's restore-side reinforcement (concurrent_gb throttle and node-lock), this time the save side was reorganized.
    • The save side gained a new ThrottledD2HArrayHandler. It overrides Orbax ArrayHandler.serialize to do D2H and write per batch, and the budget is set by save_concurrent_gb.
    • Saving is serialized per node with the XAI_SAVE_NODE_SERIALIZE env and the /dev/shm/xai_save_node_lock flock.
    • gc.collect() and malloc_trim(0) are called between batches.
    • The new restore-side function load_checkpoint_streamed is a restore variant that pushes stage→copy→evict tensor by tensor. auto-window = min(max(max_leaf, total/16), 32GB).
    • This function passes old/new array pairs through the on_replaced callback and separates aliased references in advance with copy_aliased_arrays.
    • The Trainer.warm_start_staging_spec hook does not make an opt_state copy in pinned-host during a params-only restore (keep_emb_opt_state=True option).
    • admission.reset_estimates resets the EWMA of the serving admission controller to zero.
    • The copy_port_client logging also records GB/s.
  • ✅ valid_step gating in trainer_recsys was unified. Now if either dense or embedding fails, both keep the originals. It cuts off at the source the residual effect of dense·emb grad scale divergence on Muon+GB300.
    • The param update order was rearranged in the dense sync and async_no_deferred paths.
    • Previously dense params were updated as long as they passed the dense grad-norm check, and if the emb grad-norm failed only the emb table was rolled back, which could create an asymmetric state for a few steps.
    • The unified condition is keep_step = valid_step & emb_valid_step.
    • The async path is also synchronized with AsyncEmbGradientUpdate.pending=keep_step.
    • The grad_norm_keep_threshold is None assert in _create_async_emb_executables was removed (the async path now actually consumes the threshold too).
  • ✅ An option to put follower count and bio in the grox reply_spam LM prompt was added, and Manhattan writes became monotone-only. Because the reply ranking score only goes down over time and never goes up, label flapping is eliminated at the source.
    • Two options, include_follower_count and include_bio, were added to PostRenderer.render, which renders user meta in four parts: Handle / Follower Count / Name / Bio.
    • ThreadRenderer._render_thread puts the follower count in every post of the thread when include_follower_count is on, and renders the bio for post 0 (the original) only.
    • The # Reply Author Info header states the judgment target explicitly.
    • _publish_to_reply_ranking_manhattan looks up the existing score with ReplyRankingScoreStratoLoader.fetch_reply_ranking_score. If new score > existing, it skips the write (higher_than_existing counter).
  • ✅ The media fallback cache was removed entirely from VF TesHydrator. It follows the same "remove the safety net after stabilization" trend as Gen4+8's big VMRanker simplification (Gen4+9 in the change log).
    • 292 lines were deleted. The 1M-entry LRU, serve-stale/shadow mode, and both env flags (VF_MEDIA_FALLBACK_CACHE_SERVE_STALE_ENABLED, ..._POPULATE_ENABLED) are all gone.
    • The pattern is that the safety net from the early VF rewrite was removed once consistency could be audited with the Gen4+7 reference_compare harness and TES stabilized.
  • ✅ dark_traffic no longer mirrors canary workloads. It prevents incidents in which canary issues contaminate shadow verdicts.
    • should_enable changed to should_mirror(workload, ordinal, max_ordinal).
    • With workload=None it is fail-closed, and workloads with a -canary suffix are not mirrored.
  • ✅ Three ads conversion heads were newly added to the proto. The ranker directly predicts advertiser pixel fires, and the combination of pixel and long dwell is also a separate head.
    • They are proto ActionName 191 ADS_PIXEL_FIRE, 192 ADS_LONG_DWELL_AND_PIXEL_FIRE, and 193 P_LONG_DWELL_AND_PIXEL_FIRE.
    • They are not yet reflected in constants.py and recsys_model.py (proto introduction only). The training and serving connection is a checkpoint to watch in the next commit.
  • ✅ Ads asset reuse history is carried in the serving request. It attributes cases where the same creative was shown or re-shown across multiple advertisers.
    • PredictNextActionsRequest.conv_asset_ids is connected. A new ConvAssetIds message (impressed_time_ms / author_id / asset_id 3-array) was added as field 18.
  • ✅ Two fields for reconstruction metrics were added to home-mixer's local SlateContext. They refine the served_slate_context reconstruction metrics. The proto migration is pending.
    • The fields are SlateContext.recon_count_above and recon_gap_above, and both are Option<u32>.
  • ✅ A new use_history_segment_ids flag was added to the retrieval user tower. It is off by default.
    • The default is RecsysTwoTowerModelConfig.use_history_segment_ids=False.
    • When on, user_tower_segment_ids(B, T, ...) gives history tokens HISTORY_SEGMENT_ID instead of zeros.
    • The segment mask of pallas varlen flash-attention isolates the user history segment from other special tokens (e.g., the user_features token).
  • Deep dive needed (new):
    • The production tuning value of save_concurrent_gb and how much save time increases
    • When load_checkpoint_streamed replaces the default load_checkpoint (currently both functions coexist)
    • The first active config of warm_start_staging_spec (whether it is already reflected in the flagship)
    • The actual call trigger of admission reset_estimates (hot-swap completion? traffic shift detection?)
    • Data showing that the Manhattan reply_ranking monotone-only write actually reverses observed label flaps
    • The media feature fail-close rate when TES fails after removal of the VF media fallback cache
    • The training and serving connection of ADS_PIXEL_FIRE and ADS_LONG_DWELL_AND_PIXEL_FIRE (when constants.py is updated)
    • The actual consumption point of conv_asset_ids (which head in recsys_model uses this asset history)
    • When use_history_segment_ids is promoted to production (the commit that changes it to True in the flagship)
    • The formula for recon_count_above/recon_gap_above and when the proto migration happens

Resolved by the Gen4+10 release / new (2026-08-28)

The 2026-08-28 commit (Gen4+10) introduced the ads blender, the VF safety-label cache warmer, and Phoenix checkpoint restore and serving fixes verified (blender, warmer, Phoenix). Operational values such as rollout ratio, initial settings, and production metrics remain new open questions.

  • ✅ The ads blender gained a fourth option, MultiRiskAdsBlender. It decides ad slots with an adjacency matrix that combines the ad's BSR grade and the post's risk grade.
    • The existing options are safe_gap, partition_organic, and time_gap; this commit added multi_risk.
    • Ads are split into two tiers, BsrNormal/BsrHigh, and posts into three tiers, Safe/MediumRisk/HighRisk.
    • Only BSR-high ads are allowed medium-medium slots. If an advertiser opts in to impressions in medium-risk contexts, total impressions increase.
    • A HighRisk post cannot be adjacent to any ad.
    • Three metrics, MultiRisk.enforcement, MultiRisk.slot_outcome, and MultiRisk.serving_limitation, slice two things for observation.
      • Which safety filter caused a slot to be left empty
      • Which of ads_supply/spacing/safe_posts was the binding constraint
    • The same commit also added a "partition_organic_low_risk" alias to blender_selector, bringing the options to five in total.
    • It is placed behind an experiment gate, and the default of the AdsBlenderType param has not yet been promoted.
  • ✅ A warmer was added that, on a miss in the safety-label twemcache, samples a portion of the misses and fills the cache asynchronously.
    • When twemcache returns Miss (the cache does not know this key) on a visibility/baseTweetSafetyLabelMap column lookup, SampledWarmer samples with a probability set by the VF_CACHE_WARM_SAMPLE_PCT env.
    • Sampled keys are published fire-and-forget to a tokio bounded mpsc (capacity 1024).
    • A background drain groups batches with a 500ms linger and at most 50 IDs and performs a Strato batch fetch. The results are written back to twemcache.
    • NotFound (definitively absent) is not a warming target, and FallThrough (error/timeout) is not one either. The principle is that warming resolves only unfilled cache.
    • When the bounded channel is saturated, it never blocks request handling and only increments the DroppedChannelFull counter.
    • Three new envs were also introduced: VF_GIZMODUCK_CLIENT_ID, VF_TWEMCACHE_CLIENT_NAME, and APP_ENV (staging/prod are separated automatically).
  • ✅ The Phoenix trainer now actually uses restore_streamed.
    • The load_checkpoint_streamed scaffolding from Gen4+9 was wired into maybe_load_checkpoint in this commit.
    • The activation condition is restore_streamed=True AND format == "orbax" AND save_method != "tensorstore".
    • The warm_start (do_not_load_opt_state) path benefits in particular. On this path, the pinned-host copy of the opt state is never created.
    • The _graft_replaced callback grafts loaded tensors in place into their original positions in the state tree. Aliased state leaves are blocked by an early assertion.
  • ✅ A bug where the Phoenix gRPC compression path lost response trailers was fixed.
    • When compressing with zstd, GrpcCompressionService wrapped the response body in a new axum::body::Body::from(data) and lost all gRPC trailers (grpc-status, grpc-message).
    • Clients were likely to have treated the response as ending at EOF without a status trailer.
    • Trailers are now restored with collected.trailers().cloned() and a rebuild_response helper. This is unified for both successful and failed compression.
    • Two regression tests were added.
    • The same file gained a new histogram, recsys_engine_response_compress_ms{method} (zstd encode queuing and CPU time).
  • ✅ Phoenix copy_port shuffled the shard download order per pod to even out peer load.
    • Previously, when each pod downloaded sharded tensors, all pods requested in order starting from index 0, which created a spike on the first shard peer.
    • The new shuffle_sharded_schedule(n, tensor_name) hashes POD_NAME/HOSTNAME together with the tensor name and shuffles deterministically with StdRng::seed_from_u64(hash). As a result, each pod requests in a different order.
    • Completed results are restored to the original order with restore_piece_order.
    • The two consumers, emb_table.rs and copy_port_client.rs, were unified in the same way.
    • replicated ownership keeps in-order.
    • This change extends the node-serialize and concurrent_gb hardening of Gen4+7 to the peer axis.
  • ✅ home-mixer gained three counters that observe polling requests. Regular polling refreshes and a user's initial requests can now be viewed separately in serving metrics.
    • A new file, home-mixer/util/strato_context.rs (75 new lines), extracts the StratoContext.is_polling proto field from stratocontext[-bin] metadata.
    • The stat_request_context function was wired into response_stats_side_effect.rs.
    • It increments three counters per request.
      • <feed>.request.polling{polling=true|false, client}
      • <feed>.request.request_context{request_context, client}
      • <feed>.request.client{client, client_version}
  • ✅ grox reply_spam now stores scores to Kafka first, and >= idempotency and fetch-failure handling also changed.
    • The monotone-only rule from Gen4+9 changed from > to >=, so writes are also skipped on ties. The counter name also changed from higher_than_existing to not_lower_than_existing.
    • The storage order was reversed from Manhattan-first to Kafka-first. Kafka append-only durability takes priority, and a Manhattan write failure can be recovered offline.
    • The defensive try/except in fetch_reply_ranking_score was removed. A fetch failure now propagates as a flow task failure.
    • In the same commit, include_follower_count=True was turned on permanently in the PostRenderer.render call in classifier_coordinated_spam.py. The coordinated spam verdict now receives each thread participant's follower count in the prompt.
  • ✅ abuse-enforcement gained an AIS thrift schema conformance test. CI guarantees that AES's payload schema does not drift from the downstream thrift service.
    • The new test every_action_shape_encodes_against_the_ais_schema encodes action shapes against the actual AIS thrift schema to prevent regressions.
    • The encoded targets are eight EnforcementAction shapes built with six constructors (suspend_user, add_user_label, add_post_label, bounce_arkose, bounce_captcha, spam_liveness_check). suspend_user and add_user_label each appear in two variants verified — service.rs:2104-2139.
    • The target schema is ActionIntakeService.intakeAction.
    • When a new scorer is created or a payload field is added, this test detects the problem as an early failure.
  • ✅ A regression test was added to confirm that home-mixer's CJK muted keywords match only as whole tokens.
    • The new test is test_cjk_keyword_whole_token_only in viewer_muted_keyword_filter.rs.
    • If 京都 is muted, I visited 京都 last week must be filtered out, but 東京都に行くのが楽しみ must not be (京都 is a substring of 東京都).
    • The filter itself already handles CJK word boundaries. Only the test was added this time, and its purpose is to lock down the semantics.
  • ✅ The account-list comments of Brazil2026ElectionFilter were reorganized again. The filter semantics are unchanged (the follow exception is kept).
    • Previously, 665 accounts were listed with a single repeated comment such as no live account was found / deleted account.
    • This time they were reorganized into 10 "not the candidate's actual account" verdicts and many no live account found entries.
    • Separate from the list-update practice of Gen4+8, this change tidies the tone of the documentation and comments.
  • ✅ A fallback was wired into the SimClustersInterestedIn2020 snapshot read in simclusters. The batch job became more tolerant of missing snapshots.
    • EntityToSimClustersEmbeddingsJob.scala directly inlined the InterestedInSources.simClustersInterestedIn2020Source(dateRange, timeZone) helper.
    • The inlined code consists of three parts.
      • DAL.readMostRecentSnapshot(..., dateRange.prepend(Days(28)(timeZone)))
      • ExplicitLocation(ProcAtla)
      • fallbackPath = "viewfs://.../simclusters_v2_interested_in_20M_145K_2020/_TMP_RECOVERY/{timestamp}"
    • It uses a 28-day lookback, a pin to a specific data center, and a fallback to a temporary recovery path together.
  • The deep-dive questions newly raised by this commit are as follows.
    • The experiment rollout ratio of the multi_risk blender and the share of BSR-high opt-in advertisers
    • The uplift that medium-medium placement produces in revenue/brand safety metrics
    • The initial production value of VF_CACHE_WARM_SAMPLE_PCT and the change in twemcache miss rate
    • Which service quotas the gizmoduck_client_id() staging separation splits
    • The first active config of restore_streamed (currently presumed to default to false inferred)
    • The P99 target of recsys_engine_response_compress_ms and production observation evidence of the gRPC trailer loss bug
    • The request-rate distribution of the shard 0 peer before and after the copy_port shard shuffle was introduced
    • The actual distribution of the home-mixer polling request ratio (by feed and client)
    • Changes over time in the rate at which reply_spam skips Manhattan writes (what percentage is skipped after monotone-only and >=)
    • How often the AIS conformance test actually catches regressions in the scorer development cycle

Resolved by the Gen4+11 release / new (2026-08-28)

In the 2026-08-28 commit (Gen4+11), a reranker head tag parameter was wired into the request home-mixer sends to Phoenix, and Phoenix's embedding table receive handling was moved to a blocking pool verified (change log). The VF rule-layer refactor in the same commit did not change policy verified (change log).

  • ✅ The visibility-filtering rule layer was refactored. Policy did not change, and regression-preventing assets accumulated.
    • 24 rule files were slimmed down, at +1,522/−1,151.
    • RuleContext was split into a new file, context.rs, and exposes about 25 domain methods (is_stale_tweet, viewer_country_in, has_tweet_nsfw_user_flag, etc.).
    • Condition checks in individual rules were replaced with domain method calls, and the semantics were preserved.
    • A 90-case golden corpus (golden_corpus.rs, +1039) pins verdict results across 13 categories.
    • CI enforces the every_wired_rule_decides_a_corpus_case assertion. It checks that every wired rule has at least one deciding case.
    • This is the next stage in the flow that led from Gen4+7 reference_compare to the removal of the Gen4+9 media fallback cache.
  • ✅ A RerankerHeadTag parameter was wired into the request home-mixer sends to Phoenix. The server-side consumption logic is not in this commit.
    • The new parameter is param!(RerankerHeadTag, i64, "rust_home_mixer_reranker_head_tag", 0).
    • A PostCandidate.reranker_head_tag: Option<u32> field was introduced. PhoenixScorer sends this value in the request and in scoring_sequence, and it round-trips in the response.
    • It was added symmetrically in two proto places: ScoreInfo.rerankerHeadTag = 6 and UserActionSequence.rerankerHeadTag = 9 (in the Rust and Python protos together).
    • This is a wiring stage before head routing is turned on inferred.
    • It reads as a switch for choosing one of several reranker heads in the model through an A/B experiment inferred.
  • ✅ Phoenix emb_table's gRPC receive handling was separated into a blocking pool.
    • Previously, when downloading large embedding tables, non-temporal copy and Adler-32 computation ran directly in the gRPC callback and held up tokio runtime threads.
    • Now data is pushed into a sync_channel(2) in 4 MiB chunks and run separately with tokio::task::spawn_blocking.
    • On the RDMA path as well, consumption up to the final summation is done with spawn_blocking.
    • The new helper JoinOnDrop<T> always terminates the blocking task and prevents handle leaks. The normal path uses join().await, and on drop it uses block_in_place and block_on(handle).
    • The 4 MiB chunks and sync_channel(2) backpressure regulate the receive rate.
  • ✅ copy_port_client gained a join_transfers helper, and proto_parser gained a Bytes callback type.
    • The previous four-line join_all(...spawn) → collect → map_err idiom was extracted into a single join_transfers helper (no behavior change).
    • The new Bytes callback type in proto_parser.rs (FnMut(usize, Bytes)) can pass chunks by ownership transfer.
    • emb_table still keeps the Str signature. True zero-copy is a follow-up checkpoint to watch.
  • The deep-dive questions newly raised by this commit are as follows.
    • The server-side consumption logic of RerankerHeadTag (head routing in the Phoenix Python serving code)
    • Why it was attached in two places, UserActionSequence and ScoreInfo (request/response symmetry vs. a different purpose)
    • When RerankerHeadTag is first promoted in an experiment (the commit where it changes from 0 to 1+)
    • When emb_table consumes the Bytes callback (the true zero-copy path)
    • The tail latency improvement of the tokio runtime before and after the gRPC callback separation was introduced
    • Verifying that the 90 golden corpus cases match prior production verdicts (the possibility that the refactor hid a semantic change)

Resolved by the Gen4+15 release / new (2026-09-04)

The 2026-09-04 commit (Gen4+15) changed grox reply spam verdicts, PTOS judge model assignment, Phoenix serving and training, and VF hydration all at once verified (change log). The new questions include the activation ratio of the new verdict path, the point where SID is filled into the request, and the H100 training config.

  • ✅ grox gained a second reply spam path that judges per thread chain. It is named PlanMultiStepReplySpam.
    • It feeds the whole thread into Gemma 2 as a prompt and extracts a "spam_post_indexes" set.
    • There are eight entry conditions: it is a reply, ancestors are present, root followers ≥ 1,000, root author ≠ reply author, direct parent author = reply author, not high page-rank/grey badge, not Grok/Gork, and depth ≥ 2.
    • The pattern these conditions try to catch is a time-axis coordinated spam where "one author steals root impressions through a chain in which they reply to their own replies."
    • The LM output has a three-step safeguard: newest reply not flagged → drop, other-author → drop, singleton → drop.
    • If it judges a post as spam, it forcibly stores score = 0.0.
    • The plan is injected into two streams, ReplyRankingTaskGenerator and RecoveryTaskGenerator.
    • A time-axis collusion axis, alongside Coordinated_spam (account collusion), is added to the canon.
  • ✅ The first concrete case of the PTOS judge stack using a different model per category was confirmed.
    • Gen4+7 assigned a single model, EAPI_GROK_4_5_X_ALGO, to the SafetyPtosPolicyCrossValidator of three categories (ChildSafety, ViolentMedia, IllegalAndRegulatedBehaviors).
    • In this commit, only IllegalAndRegulatedBehaviors was migrated to EAPI_GROK_4_1_FAST_X_ALGO.
    • This call is made directly without a Breaker, and the metric name also changed to ..._with_grok_4_1.
    • The policy of X tuning judge models separately per category was stated explicitly.
  • ✅ Gemma 4 was promoted to first-pass for IllegalAndRegulatedBehaviors, and the Gemma probability dial was removed.
    • USE_GEMMA_CATEGORIES = {Spam, IllegalAndRegulatedBehaviors} (previously Spam only).
    • The if random.random() < self.use_oai_gemma4_dial probability gate was removed entirely, so both categories are routed 100% to Gemma.
    • The removed dial value had been 1.0 since the Gen4 release, so Spam behavior did not change verified — classifier.py in 47c1bcd and 85ac72a. The actual change is that IllegalAndRegulatedBehaviors moved to Gemma.
    • task_safety_ptos_policy.py also added IllegalAndRegulatedBehaviors to the reclassification trigger. This completes the three-stage stack (Gemma first-pass → deluxe cross-model → Grok 4.1-fast judge).
  • ✅ The SID retrieval sidecar was removed completely from Phoenix serving. History SIDs now arrive carried in the request.
    • Five things were deleted.
      • sid_client.rs (189 lines)
      • sid_retrieval_runner.py (17 lines)
      • --sid_endpoint CLI
      • The xai-recsys-sid-proto dependency
      • The PySemanticIdClient Python binding
    • The log keeps the phrase "Parsing history SIDs from the request (sid_num_levels=%d); no sid_endpoint".
    • The responsibility for SID codeword lookup moved out of online serving. The contract is that home-mixer (or the candidate hydration layer) already puts the SIDs in when it builds the request.
    • One gRPC call per request is eliminated, and the fault domain of the SID infrastructure shrinks.
  • ✅ The default of Phoenix use_pinned_d2h changed from False to True.
    • D2H transfer speed is ~50 GB/s with CUDA pinned host memory, versus ~3 GB/s for the JAX default. It saves ~29ms per inference.
    • This option was introduced in Gen4+6, and its default changed in this commit.
  • ✅ Phoenix training gained a remat policy for H100. It is the first code signal that training also runs on H100 besides GB300.
    • The new policy is SAVE_H100_RECSYS = 32, and it entered custom_remat_policy as a new branch.
    • It designates the same name list as GB300 (attn_outputs, dense_outputs, gate_up_proj, query_heads, key_heads, value_heads, etc.) as rematerialization save targets.
    • A hardware-specific config block such as _H100_OVERRIDES is not yet in this commit.
    • The fact that X's training hardware is not only GB300 is itself new content to fold into the canon.
  • ✅ The FA4 attention kernel now natively supports variable-length history.
    • hist_valid_len was added to the build_dense_block_sparse_layout signature.
    • Layout computation moved from numpy to jax.numpy (cache removed).
    • Two masking fields, valid_block_upper and valid_block_lower, were added so the kernel handles partial-history blocks directly. A partial-history block is a block whose valid tokens inside a tile are at most the tile size.
    • Training and inference accuracy improve for new users and short sessions.
    • The varlen semantics of Gen4+6 cutedsl_ranker_varlen_attn were extended to the history axis.
  • ✅ The hydration and safety-label code in visibility-filtering was simplified considerably. Over 800 lines were removed in net.
    • The reduced files include registry.rs −378, safety_label_source/codec.rs −206, hydration/mod.rs −90, hydration/fallback_cache.rs −87, and config.rs −118.
    • The flow of "removing the safety net after the rewrite stabilized" continues. The earlier steps are the removal of the media fallback cache in Gen4+9, the deletion of 128 lines of VMRanker in +8, the rules refactor in +11, and the elimination of Box<dyn Rule> in +14.
    • In the same commit, fixtures.rs +81 and golden_corpus.rs +102 made the regression safety net thicker.
  • ✅ Brazil2026ElectionFilter was refreshed on schedule. The regular refresh practice of Gen4+8 continues. It is a signal that verification of politician X account mappings continues every week.
    • 166 account IDs were added as hardcoded entries, taking the set from 2,388 to 2,554 verified — brazil_2026_election_filter.rs. Examples of added accounts are +@nanacachen, +@AecioNeves, +@lgmbrasilia, +@crismonteirosp, +@rodrigolimamdh, +@samiabomfim, and +@gabrielmagno_13.
    • A few more "not the candidate's actual account" verdicts were also added.
  • ✅ PR #88 (e4dcedd) from an external contributor was merged. It is evidence that Gen4's open-source stance actually accepts external PRs.
    • Two lines were added to vf_candidate_hydrator.rs that dedup in_network_ids before the VF lookup.
  • The deep-dive questions newly raised by this commit are as follows.
    • The initial active traffic ratio and verdict metrics of PlanMultiStepReplySpam (experiment gating is not in this diff)
    • The tuning history of FOLLOWER_COUNT_THRESHOLD_FOR_SPAM_DETECTION = 1000
    • How multi-step verdict results are reflected in reply ranking in experiments
    • The name and source of the hydrator that fills SID in home-mixer or the candidate hydration layer (the point that puts SID into the request after sid_client was removed)
    • The SID codeword storage backend (Manhattan? Strato? phoenix-rankall itself?)
    • The first active config of SAVE_H100_RECSYS (which recipe is trained on H100)
    • When _H100_OVERRIDES appears and the batch/attn/remat tuning differences between H100 and GB300
    • What the 206-line deletion in safety_label_source/codec.rs actually removed (which wire format or label source)
    • How EAPI_GROK_4_1_FAST_X_ALGO differs from 4.5 X_ALGO (latency, cost, and accuracy trade-offs)
    • The next category expansion candidates (the next Gemma promotion targets after Spam and IllegalAndRegulatedBehaviors, and when the ChildSafety and ViolentMedia judges move to 4.1-fast)

The new vm-ranker/config_sync.rs (+235) handles parameter updates. Every 30 seconds it sparse-clones and resets a git remote, polls features/home-mixer/main/rust_home_mixer.yml and abdecider/abdecider.yml, and hot-reloads without a process restart. A path that skips head recomputation for cached candidates was introduced. The home-mixer param CachedPostsReuseWeightedScore, RankingScorer::reuses_cached_weighted_score(), and unoffset_score() make up this path. An experiment payload channel was introduced. The home-mixer param VMRankerSendDebiasInputs and the new home-mixer/scorers/vm_ranker_debias_payload.rs (+52) put per-candidate content features and the request context into the experiment_payload proto field. The content features are has_video, max_video_duration_ms, has_photo, media_count, weighted_text_len, newline_count, has_url, and their quoted equivalents. The request context is engine_time_hint_ms, a columnar user-sequence ArrowIPC, product_surface, and client_app_id. The home-mixer vm_ranker.rs became thinner (15/−31). The four-mode branching that was inline is now encapsulated in the struct OptionalInputs { value_model, compute_value_model, cached_weighted_score, debias }. The response tuple was extended to (score, weighted_score). New metrics on the value model path are vm_ranker_value_model_requests_total{mode=passthrough|value_model|fallback}, vm_ranker_value_model_fallback_total{reason=...}, and vm_ranker_value_model_stage_total{stage=heads|cached_weighted}. Five vm_ranker_config_sync_* metrics and vm_ranker_params_resolved_total were also introduced. The VF conversation-control slot was filled with four rules. The LimitedEngagementReason::ConversationControl slot reserved the day before (3aa0fa33) is now actually wired. The new hydrator visibility-filtering/hydration/conversation_control_hydrator.rs (+310) looks up the arm, root author, and invited users through TES get_conversation_controls(). For the Community arm, the new socialgraph call batch_check_followed_by(viewer_id, root_authors) (reverse edge) checks whether the root author follows the viewer. For the Subscribers arm, batch_check_super_follows(viewer_id, root_authors) checks whether the viewer super-follows the root. The result goes into ConversationControlFeatures { control, root_author_follows_viewer, viewer_super_follows_root_author } in the new type visibility-filtering/models/conversation_control.rs. The four new rules are in visibility-filtering/rules/tweet_rules.rs:328-383. Each rule assigns LimitedEngagementReason::ConversationControl to the reply engagement of viewers who do not meet the condition of its arm. LimitRepliesByInvitationConversationRule targets viewers who were not invited, and LimitRepliesCommunityConversationRule targets viewers who are not followed. LimitRepliesSubscribersConversationRule targets viewers who do not super-follow, and LimitRepliesVerifiedConversationRule targets unverified viewers. Viewer::LoggedIn(u64) was expanded to Viewer::LoggedIn { id, profile: ViewerProfile { allows_sensitive_media, viewer_age, has_verified_badge, account_country_code } }. has_verified_badge is true when the Gizmoduck value is VerifiedType::Business/Government or is_blue_verified is set. VF hydration was reorganized to be lazy. The new enum Hydrator (7 variants) and the bitset Hydrators(u8) were introduced in visibility-filtering/hydration/mod.rs (+360/−77). Each predicate declares its requirements with const fn hydrators(), and RuleClause::hydrators() takes their union. RuleEngine::hydrators_for(safety_level) runs only the hydrators that the active policy actually references. A large amount of TES hydration code was deleted (tes_hydrator.rs -333, models/mod.rs -223, safety_label_source/lookup.rs -89). This is a consequence of TweetForVisibility having been migrated to the Strato column the day before. The PureCoreHydration wrapper and the cache-recovery logic were removed, and renaming fetch_pure_core → fetch_author_ids simplified it to TweetHydrationBatch<AuthorId>. A key-frame pipeline was introduced for grox video safety. KeyFramesExtractor in the new grox/libs/video_tools/key_frames.py (+206) detects scene cuts with PyAV and OpenCV. A frame counts as a scene cut when the L2 delta of a 32×32 grayscale signature exceeds max(6.0, 4.0×median_delta). It then decodes the top 3 midframes per shot by salience rank, frame-exact by PTS (3-second window, 15 fps; blank shots with stddev<8.0 rank lower). The DAG in the new grox/flows/ptos/plan_safety_ptos_key_frames.py (+52) starts with rate limit → key frames filter → media hydration → adult-only init. It continues with policy detection → safemodel sex/nudity → adult content cross-validation → sink. The gating condition of the filter task_safety_ptos_key_frames_filter.py (+81) is: video required, fav ≥ HIGH_FAV_THRESHOLD=128, and (an existing adult label OR fav ≥ KEY_FRAMES_UNCONDITIONAL_FAV=512) (grox/flows/ptos/constants.py:25, 43). The rate limit is a 60s TTL with a 10k dedupe. Media storage switched from blobstore to the O2 S3 protocol. The new S3Store (boto3, https://o2-https.o2-prod.atla-prod-storage.cluster.kube.int-x.ai) in grox/core/data_loaders/media_reference_bundle.py replaced it by parsing s3://<bucket>/<prefix> URIs. MediaHydrationConfig gained use_key_frames (default False), key_frames_window_seconds=3.0, key_frames_max_fps=15.0, and key_frames_max=3. The MOE cold-start experiment was migrated. The default placements of PhoenixMOEMaxResults and PhoenixMoeColdStartMaxResults were swapped, and the PhoenixRetrievalMOEInferenceClusterId cluster constant was replaced.
Gen4+28 same repo @ 44d37eb 2026-09-24 Rust/Python The entire ranking scorer file in home-mixer was deleted, and the shared value model crate that was called inline the day before was released as actual files. 22 ranking computation parameters left home-mixer param.rs and remain only in the vm-ranker/params.rs mirror, and if the vm-ranker call fails, home-mixer serves the local weighted sum as is daily. +2,569/−2,257 (62 files). The entire ranking_scorer.rs file (1,255 lines) in home-mixer was deleted. The shared crate that was the inline call target the day before (1b3fec20) was released this time as 6 actual files (807 lines in total). The new files are xai-value-model/lib.rs (+14), inputs.rs (+35), phoenix_scores.rs (+28), proto.rs (+92), scoring.rs (+444), and weights.rs (+194). The exposed symbols are ValueModelWeights (34 fields), CandidateScoringInputs, QueryScoringContext, PhoenixScores (26 fields), compute_value_scores, compute_value_scores_with_adjustment, fuse_heads, compute_weighted_score, offset_score, post_fusion_multipliers, apply_cold_start_decisions, diversity_multiplier, author_pool_counts, PostFusionMultiplier, ValueScores, and NEGATIVE_SCORES_OFFSET=0.001. The only replacement adapter on the home-mixer side is the new home-mixer/scorers/value_model.rs (+114). weights_for(query) fills the 34 fields of ValueModelWeights with 29 FS parameters and 5 fixed values, and weighted_score() calls fuse_heads of the shared crate as is. 22 ranking computation parameters were deleted from home-mixer param.rs. The deleted parameters are EnableAuthorDiversity, AuthorDiversityDecay, AuthorDiversityFloor, OonWeightFactor, MultiplierPreOffset, EnableOonRescoreForInNetworkRepliesRetweets, TopicOonWeightFactor, NewUserAgeThresholdSecs, NewUserOonWeightFactor, EnableMultiplicativePostUnexplored, MultiplicativePostUnexploredAlpha, PostUnexploredWeightInNetworkOnly, EnableCdwellOnImpr, ContActiveSecs5mResidualNormWeight, WeightPerturbationSigma, WeightPerturbationSalt, EnableVMRanker, VMRankerDppTheta, VMRankerDppMaxSelectedRank, VMRankerSendValueModelInputs, VMRankerComputeValueModel, and CachedPostsReuseWeightedScore. The only mirror of these values is now vm-ranker/params.rs (56 parameters, introduced the day before). The param.rs sync time changed as 2026-09-22T17:39:32Z → 2026-09-23T16:28:43Z. home-mixer/scorers/vm_ranker.rs was restructured as local-first, RPC-refine (+84/−76). The new function local_scores() first computes the per-candidate local weighted sum and the cold-start decisions of AuthorColdStart::apply_with_decisions(), and then requests a refinement from the vm-ranker gRPC. If the RPC fails, the local weighted sum is served as is. Previously, Err was propagated per candidate. The EnableVMRanker gate was removed and migrated to EnableRanking. The HOME_HOT = 14 dataset was introduced in Phoenix retrieval. In phoenix/xrex/data/retrieval_dataset.py (+103/−8), HOME_HOT is registered next to HOME_COLD = 13. Both come from the same 1fav_1day.parquet source. What separates them is cold_pool_mask(post_ids, meta_path, max_favs=8, max_views=500) × fresh_post_mask(post_ids, max_age_seconds) in the new phoenix/xrex/data/cold_pool_filter.py (+78). HOME_COLD is cold_keep, and HOME_HOT is its complement. Phoenix bundle export was extended to carry per-target index metadata. The RetrievalExport dataclass in phoenix/xrex/train/recsys_bundle_export.py (+170/−46) gained 4 fields: dataset_capacities, rows_from, max_age_seconds, and optional_targets. The same file also gained the constants POST_SCALES_KEY and DATASET_RANGES_KEY and gating for enable_int8_post_table, enable_bloom_filter, and enable_topic_filter. VF merges the verdicts of a retweet and its source. Verdict::merge_retweet_verdict(retweet, source) was added in visibility-filtering/models/verdict.rs (+60). The source's Withheld takes precedence, and the retweet's Withheld is kept when it wins over a non-Withheld source. If the retweet is fully unrestricted it inherits the source; in all other cases the retweet is kept. The actual flow is in visibility-filtering/evaluate_tweets.rs (+157/−18). After the first evaluation, it collects the source_tweet_id of the evaluated retweets and splits them into in_batch and fetched. For fetched, it calls filter_tweets.run() a second time. It then looks up the source verdict and applies merge_retweet_verdict. The new metric is evaluate_tweets_retweet_sources{outcome=in_batch|fetched}. As supporting changes, pure_cores: TweetHydrationBatch<PureCore> and a retry-oriented PureCoreFallbackCache were added to visibility-filtering/hydration/mod.rs (+244/−18). VF's clock_cache.rs (412 lines) was deleted. The primitive that was introduced as "unwired" on 2026-09-10 (Gen4+19) was removed after 14 days. grox PTOS gained a new category, AgeGatingHarmfulText. It has 5 subtypes: AdultContent, EatingDisorder, HarmfulSubstance, DangerousStunt, and GraphicDescription. It was added to the USE_GEMMA_CATEGORIES set in grox/flows/ptos/state.py (+6) and classifier.py (+5). As of this commit, the only other categories in this set are Spam and IllegalAndRegulatedBehaviors. The prompt helper is age_gating_harmful_text_policy_prompt(), and the template .j2 body is not in this commit's tree. GROK_GEMMA_FOLLOWER_SPLIT for grox reply spam rose from 225k to 250k. This is the eleventh increase since it started at 15k in the Gen4 release. Attribution of SimClusters retrieval contribution was added to home-mixer scored_stats. The Phoenix.RetrievalContribution.SimclustersTopK family was introduced with the buckets [50, 100, 200, 400, 600, 800]. Phoenix.RetrievalContribution.ScoredTopK observes the top-k source distribution over all selected and non-selected candidates.
