Why it matters

  • This is the first change to the weight mirror values since Gen4+37. It raised the like and dwell shares and lowered the video open share to less than one third verified. However, the VM-Ranker mirror keeps its previous values, so the actual serving values cannot be confirmed inferred.
  • Retrieval also put dwell into its objective verified. Together with Gen4+31 (ContClickDwellTimeWeight 0 → 0.4), Gen4+38 (CREAD), and this ranking cont_dwell_time increase, X appears to keep increasing the share of the dwell signal from retrieval through ranking inferred.
  • The reply ranker is a design opposite to the README claim that home Phoenix "removed hand-engineered features" verified (feature list). This gives one more piece of evidence that the same company applies different principles depending on the surface.

Gen4+41 (2026-10-14, 17c96bf) — A page-level RL re-ranker for the immersive surface (page_rl: autoregressive page decoder + twin critic, training config introduced, serving off by default) + home-mixer cron mirror favorite 0.6 → 0.66 and not_interested −47.52 → −52.272 + installed-apps feature off for the home ranker + DPP skipped by default for topic requests + Brazil election filter reduced to 25 accounts

This commit released the training code for an RL re-ranker for the immersive surface that picks the slots of a page one at a time, but the serving switch is off by default. In the home-mixer cron mirror, the like and not-interested weights both became 1.1 times their previous values verified (daily).

The change spans 53 files verified — xai-org/x-algorithm@17c96bf. The cron mirror sync time went from 2026-10-12T16:00:33Z to 2026-10-13T16:00:30Z. The reference commit for line numbers is 17c96bf. The three new files first appeared in this commit, so their line numbers equal the new-file line numbers in the diff.

A. Training code for the page-level RL re-ranker page_rl appeared. verified — phoenix/xrex/models/page_rl.py (403 lines), page_decoder.py (592 lines), page_critic.py (211 lines), configs/xrecsys.py:388-417, 477-483:

  • The training config immersive_page_rl was introduced. It adds the H100 settings to the home ranker base (_home_direct_packed_base) and turns on page_rl=PageRlConfig(enabled=True). The Kafka training topic is also separate, user_action_sequence_immersive_page_rl verified — data_feeds.py.
  • The structure is actor-critic. First, a weighted-sum score (behavior score) is built from the head probabilities of the Phoenix ranker, and the top 48 at most (max_steps) are cut as the candidate pool. Then the page decoder picks slots one at a time, autoregressively. The number of slots picked at serving time is 12 (serve_steps) verified — page_decoder.py:22-34, page_rl.py:340-391.
  • The logit the decoder assigns at each step is the sum of three terms verified — page_decoder.py:85-119, 233-247.
    • "the state attending to the items picked so far × the candidate key"
    • the standardized behavior score (score_anchor_alpha=1.0)
    • a negatively weighted penalty for whether the author is the same as an already picked item and how many leading SID levels overlap
  • In this structure, diversity is learned inside the decoder rather than applied as a post-hoc rule.
  • The reward is per-slot dwell time. A slot viewed for 3 seconds or more gets 0.1 × min(dwell seconds, 300) × (1 + min(engagement count, 3)), and it is 0 if there is any negative action (not interested, report, block, mute, show less). If the page is shown to the end and the last slot has a video quality view (VQV), a completion bonus of 1.0 is added. The suffix return is computed with a discount rate γ=0.8 verified — page_rl.py:51-59, 100-158.
  • There are two critics (twin). The smaller (min) of the two critic values is used. Training uses a TD(λ=0.9) target. The return loss on exploration pages (requests with a logged rerank probability) gets a weight of 9.0. There is also a continuation head that predicts whether the page continues to the next slot verified — page_critic.py:18-25, 121-139, 174-193.
  • The actor loss has three terms, to which a behavior cloning loss (weight 0.25) that imitates the logged order is added verified — page_decoder.py:37-48, 495-592, page_rl.py:80-88.
    • The first term is an advantage based on the critic Q. The support is limited to candidates within 0.6 of the highest behavior score.
    • The second term is a KL leash toward the behavior policy (score softmax, τ=0.2). The target is 0.35, and β is adjusted automatically between 0.1 and 3.0 as a dual variable.
    • The third term is a penalty (weight 0.5) for placing the same author or similar SIDs consecutively.
  • For serving decoding, if the temperature is 0, it builds 4 beams and picks the beam with the largest sum of critic values; if it is above 0, it uses Gumbel sampling verified — page_decoder.py:427-477.
  • The behavior score contains separate weights that differ from the home-mixer mirror verified — page_rl.py:62-77, 286-337.
    • favorite 0.5, reply 2.0, retweet 1.0, click 0.4, profile_click 0.5, VQV 0.5 (only for videos longer than 10 seconds), share 40.0, quote 5.0, cont_dwell_time 0.1, not_interested −500, report −1000, not_dwelled −1.2
    • It is not possible to tell whether these values are the serving defaults or only training defaults inferred. They are config class defaults and there is no mirror comment.
    • In the 2026-10-16 commit (Gen4+43, bc3948b), VQV changed from 0.5 to 1.0 and share from 40.0 to 4.0, and the weights can now be overridden per request (Gen4+43 in the change log).
  • serve_page_decoder: bool = False was added to the serving runner verified — inference/model_runner.py:3984. No code in home-mixer uses the decoder output in this diff verified (the 3 changed home-mixer files are only the filter, param, and phoenix_source.rs).
  • Because the training data already has the fields rl_served_slot, rl_rerank_prob, rl_decode_prob, and rl_impressed, we infer that some form of probabilistic re-ranking is already running on part of the traffic and leaving logs inferred. The logged probability fields are for off-policy training, and a policy that is not served produces no logs. The rewardRerankSlotProb proto field from Gen4+4 may be the source of this log inferred.
  • Because the surface name is immersive, the vertical video immersive surface appears to be the first target inferred. The evidence is the config name and the completion bonus tied to VQV.

B. Two home-mixer cron mirror weights changed. verified — home-mixer/params/param.rs:320, 414-419:

Parameter Before After
FavoriteWeight 0.6 0.66
NotInterestedWeight −47.52 −52.272
  • Both values are exactly 1.1 times the previous ones verified (arithmetic). The NotInterestedWeight change in Gen4+31, −43.2 → −47.52, was also 1.1 times. This appears to be a rollout practice of raising values step by step in 10% increments inferred. The only evidence is that three changes have the same ratio.
  • The VM-Ranker mirror keeps favorite 0.5 (line 3) and not_interested −47.52 (lines 108-113) verified — vm-ranker/params.rs. The weights on which the two mirrors diverge now number five (PostUnexploredWeight, favorite, video_open, cont_dwell_time, not_interested).

C. Other feed-related changes

  • In the home ranker base _home_direct_packed_base, enable_user_installed_apps changed from True to False verified — configs/xrecsys.py:300. After two-tower retrieval turned off the same feature in Gen4+40, the ranker turned it off too. xrecsys_seqpack (line 430) is still True.
  • In VM-Ranker, topic requests skip DPP diversity re-ranking by default verified — vm-ranker/scoring/mod.rs:85-87, vm-ranker/params.rs:241-246. The default of the new switch TopicDppEnabled is false. We presume the reasoning is that a topic feed is already gathered around one topic, so semantic diversification does not fit inferred.
  • PhoenixSource records the number of candidates from the ZERO_FAV retrieval channel per request as a metric (ScoredStats.PhoenixRetrievalZeroFavTweets.Retrieved) verified — sources/phoenix_source.rs. This attaches an observability metric to the channel introduced in Gen4+40.
  • The Brazil2026ElectionFilter list was reduced to 25 accounts related to the runoff verified. Details are in the filter section.
  • We infer that the remaining changes are not directly related to feed ranking behavior inferred.
    • These include the abuse-enforcement action_control and confidence refactors, VF hydration cleanup, the FA4 attention kernel, and moving the reply ranker's SID decoder path.

Why it matters

  • For the first time, X released training code for a stage in which the For You family of surfaces goes beyond score-order sorting and post-hoc DPP diversification and generates the whole slate with RL verified (the code exists). The serving switch is off by default, so the actual deployment scope cannot be confirmed inferred.
  • The reward is not engagement probability but dwell time × an engagement multiplier, and it is 0 if there is a negative action verified. In the same direction as Gen4+38 (CREAD), Gen4+40 (the ld head), and this mirror change, the trend of making dwell the main objective has extended to the re-ranking stage inferred.

Gen4+42 (2026-10-15, 92f0918) — Path that blends the immersive-surface model's VQV prediction into the video carousel selection score (off by default) + ads author brand-safety fallback on by default + VF rule definition layer rewrite

With this commit, the For You video carousel can pick videos by blending in the immersive-surface model's video quality view (VQV) prediction, but the default weight is 0.0, so default behavior is the same as before verified. In the same commit, the ads brand-safety fallback that substitutes an author-level label when no post-level Grok safety label exists became on by default, and the VF rule definition layer was rewritten with no policy change verified (daily).

The commit changed 57 files verified — xai-org/x-algorithm@92f0918. The home-mixer changes cover 12 files and about 330 lines, and most of the rest (about 8,000 lines) is in visibility-filtering. The cron mirror sync time went from 2026-10-13T16:00:30Z to 2026-10-14T16:00:44Z. The commit used for line numbers is 92f0918.

A. The video carousel selection score became a weighted sum of the video_open probability and the immersive VQV prediction verified — home-mixer/util/video_carousel.rs:17-21, 104-123, params/param.rs:1083-1106.

  • The sort score for carousel videos changed from the video_open probability alone to a weighted sum of two predictions. The defaults are a video_open weight of 1.0 and a VQV weight of 0.0, so default behavior is the same as before verified.
    • The formula is VideoCarouselVideoOpenWeight × video_open + VideoCarouselImmersiveVqvWeight × immersive_vqv.
    • A video with no immersive score gets 0 for that term.
  • If the VQV weight is not 0, two components are turned on. One is a hydrator that fetches the user behavior sequence once more with a different aggregation. The other is a scorer that requests predictions for the carousel target videos from a different Phoenix cluster (Experiment3Fou) with ProductSurface::GalleryPage verified.
    • ImmersiveScoringSequenceQueryHydrator fetches the user behavior sequence once more with the IMMERSIVE_LONG_DWELL aggregation verified. IMMERSIVE_LONG_DWELL (=29) is an aggregation type that existed only as a proto name since Gen4+19, and this is the first home-mixer code that consumes it verified — query_hydrators/immersive_scoring_sequence_query_hydrator.rs (new, 75 lines).
      • The home ranker's default aggregation is DENSE_WITH_LONG_DWELL (params/param.rs lines 163-168).
    • ImmersiveVideoScorer collects only the carousel's target videos and requests predictions for them verified — scorers/immersive_video_scorer.rs (new, 65 lines), util/phoenix_request.rs:228-252.
  • The scorer order is PhoenixScorer → ImmersiveVideoScorer → VMRanker verified — candidate_pipeline/phoenix_candidate_pipeline.rs:462-471.
  • The immersive prediction is stored only in the immersive_scores field and does not enter the For You main feed score verified.
    • The diff has no code in which weighted_score or VMRanker reads this field.
  • The same weighted sum applies to both stages of carousel selection verified — selectors/top_k_score_selector.rs:16-25, filters/video_carousel_filter.rs.
    • The TopKScoreSelector stage, which picks 30 carousel candidates from outside the top 50
    • The VideoCarouselFilter stage, which picks the final 3–5 after the filter
  • Because GalleryPage, Experiment3Fou, and IMMERSIVE_LONG_DWELL are all names from the immersive vertical-video surface, we infer the aim is to pick the carousel's first screen with the model of the immersive viewer that follows a carousel tap inferred. The evidence is the names of the three identifiers and the fact that the Gen4+41 immersive_page_rl reward counts VQV completion separately.

B. The ads author brand-safety fallback became on by default verified — params/param.rs:807-812. EnableAdsAuthorBrandSafetyFallback, introduced off by default in Gen4+35, changed from false to true. This switch turns on a path that substitutes an author-level label (GrokSfa/GrokNsfaLimited/GrokNsfa) when no post-level Grok safety label exists. The detailed behavior is in the Gen4+35 section. As a result, the V2 verdict switch that returned to on by default in Gen4+35 and the author fallback switch introduced in the same commit are both on by default verified. The V2 verdict switch itself has existed since Gen4+2 (2026-08-17) (param.rs at b089ce6).

C. Other changes

  • One assert line in Phoenix recsys_model.py that required right_anchored_rope when seqpack (packing that concatenates several user sequences into one batch row) is on was deleted verified — phoenix/xrex/models/recsys_model.py.
    • We infer the aim is to allow experiments that train on packed sequences with a RoPE that is not right-anchored inferred. The evidence is that this commit only lifted the constraint and made no other config change.
  • The VF rule definitions changed from a flat condition array to a boolean tree. The rule lists, order, actions, and country lists of the five SafetyLevels are unchanged verified — visibility-filtering/rules/levels.rs, rules/rule_spec/rule.rs (new, 305 lines).
    • The old format is Clause { when: &[Cond] } and the new format is Rule { when: RuleCond }. The tree is built from all!/any!/!/named conditions.
    • The five SafetyLevels are FILTER_ALL, TIMELINE_HOME, TIMELINE_HOME_RECOMMENDATIONS, TIMELINE_HOME_HYDRATION, and IMMERSIVE_EXPANDED_RECOMMENDATIONS.
  • The commit added a test adapter that prints the new tree back out as the old flat table and compares it with the existing per-level golden files. The golden files did not change, so there is no policy change verified.
    • The adapter is rules/legacy_table.rs and is test-only.
    • This is the fifth "no policy change" refactor, following Gen4+11, +13, +14, and +29.
  • The same rule definition produces evaluation, policy catalog documentation, and a per-node verdict trace. The serving path uses short-circuit evaluation without a trace verified.
    • Catalog documentation is generated by the test-only rules/catalog.rs.
    • The verdict trace is produced by rules/rule_spec/observed.rs (new, 275 lines).
    • The debug tool explain.rs exposes this trace and the retweet merge selection (MergeSelection).
  • We infer the direction is to explain "why was this post hidden" per rule inferred. The evidence is the Effect enum, which records for each row how a rule line contributed to the verdict.
  • Behavior may change in two hydration places outside the rules verified (code).
    1. The viewer Gizmoduck (X's user information service) lookup changed verified — clients/gizmoduck_client.rs:23-29, 55-62. It used to be called without context (None), and it is now called with a LookupContext that includes include_soft_users, deactivated, erased, offboarded, and other states. The test is named viewer_lookups_include_every_user_state_tweetypie_reads, so we infer the change aligns the lookup scope with the Tweetypie reference (Gen4+31) inferred.
    2. When a found viewer has no age information, it is now decoded as NotStated regardless of state verified — hydration/decode/viewer.rs:76-79.
  • When the two changes combine, viewers in states that were not looked up before may become subject to the SENSITIVE_VIEWER_NO_STATED_AGE_DROP_* rules inferred. The scale cannot be determined from the diff.
  • The viewer state and age distribution metrics vf_viewer_state and vf_viewer_age (with a country tag) were introduced verified — hydration/metrics.rs.
  • The commit also added a pre-check (fail-closed) that fails every candidate of a request when a hydrator required by the policy is missing from the plan, but because the plan is derived from the same policy, it does not fire on the normal path inferred — rules/registry.rs:418-443.
  • In visibility-filtering/params.rs and limited_actions_policy.rs, only the visibility modifiers changed to pub, and the values are the same verified.

Why it matters

  • In Gen4+38, the carousel picked videos by "the video-open probability predicted by the main feed model." This commit added a path that picks by importing the video quality view (VQV) prediction of a model trained for a different surface verified (code). This is the first release of a structure in which a module inside one feed calls a surface-specific model separately verified.
  • This path follows the Gen4+40 cut of the video_open weight (0.07 → 0.02) and points the same way as the shift of the video-side objective from "open" to "time actually watched and video quality view" inferred. The default is 0, so whether it is served is unknown.

Gen4+43 (2026-10-16, bc3948b) — PopularPostsSource label split (ForYouPopularPosts) + page_rl behavior score weight change (VQV 0.5 → 1.0, share 40 → 4) and per-request weight override + carousel embedding dedup (off by default) + VF auxiliary lookups made best-effort + brand engagement label

With this commit, candidates from the popular posts source carry their own label, and in the behavior score of the immersive page re-ranker the video quality view weight doubled and the share weight fell to one tenth verified. In visibility-filtering, a verdict now counts as complete even if 13 auxiliary lookups fail, and the tests state explicitly that rare over-drops can occur as the cost verified (daily).

The commit is xai-org/x-algorithm@bc3948b verified. The cron mirror sync time went from 2026-10-14T16:00:44Z to 2026-10-15T16:00:34Z. The commit used for line numbers is bc3948b.

A. The popular posts source label was split from Phoenix retrieval. verified — home-mixer/sources/popular_posts_source.rs:13

Decoder serving is still off by default.

D. The auxiliary lookups in visibility-filtering became best-effort (a behavior change). verified — visibility-filtering/hydration/plan.rs:375-409, hydration/mod.rs:30, rules/registry.rs:167-175:

  • The training label IsBrandEngagement was introduced. The 10 positive actions are like, reply, retweet, author follow, click, link open, profile click, photo expand, and carousel swipe (forward and back); video watch milestones and dwell are not included verified — phoenix/crates/serving/xai-recsys-proto/src/brand_engagement.rs:5-19.

Why it matters

  • ⚠ Claim changed: the statement in the 2026-10-03 commit (Gen4+35) subsection that "PopularPostsSource candidates are mixed in under the Phoenix retrieval label and cannot be distinguished" no longer holds from this commit (Gen4+43) verified.

The higher VQV weight points the same way as the carousel VQV path in the 2026-10-15 commit (Gen4+42) inferred.
  • The VF change tolerates failures of auxiliary relationship lookups to reduce latency, and the tests state explicitly that rare over-drops can occur as the cost verified (test comments).

Gen4+44 (2026-10-17, 862a123) — Three video carousel dedup checks on by default + carousel removed when Who-to-Follow is present + post engagers list feature (PostEngagers, on only in shadow traffic) + ZeroFav channel two-sided experiment filter (off by default) + two-tower microbatch shared candidate pool

With this commit, three dedup checks inside the For You video carousel, which is off by default, became on by default, and the carousel is no longer inserted when the same response has a Who-to-Follow module verified. The commit also added a feature that puts the list of user IDs who engaged with a candidate post into the ranker request; it is off by default and always on in shadow traffic verified (daily).

The visibility-filtering, abuse-enforcement, and bdsm changes are renames (FilterTweets → PostEvaluator, rules/registry.rs → rules/engine.rs, and so on), metrics, and a Kafka authentication change (SASL → mTLS) inferred. We found no place where what gets filtered out of the feed changed inferred. We did not read every VF hunk line by line.

  • For each candidate post, the commit fetches the list of user IDs who engaged with that post from a Redis cache (post-engagers-cache, response timeout 200ms) and puts it in the new ranking request field TweetInfo.postEngagers = 39.

    • Each entry has a user ID, the action bits actionBits, and the seconds elapsed since the engagement ageSecs.
    • It holds up to 32 positive and up to 8 negative users.

  • Engagements by the viewer and those after the serving time are excluded. We infer this is a device to prevent training-time leakage inferred. The evidence is the engaged_at_secs <= serve_secs condition and the fact that requests to the experiment cluster use the candidate's last_scored_at_ms as the serving time.

  • The field is cleared when the request is stored in the cache — side_effects/phoenix_request_cache_side_effect.rs:95-98. This diff has no code in which a Phoenix model reads this field verified.

  • In shadow traffic, opt-in clusters (for example, Experiment18Fou) now receive 0% unless explicitly overridden — util/shadow.rs:9-29.

D. The two-sided experiment filter ZeroFavCodivertFilter for the ZeroFav channel was introduced, off by default. verified — filters/zero_fav_codivert_filter.rs:44-80, 105-110, params/param.rs:230-247

  • If the viewer is in treatment, a candidate that came in only through the ZeroFav retrieval channel (ForYouPhoenixRetrievalZeroFav) from the 2026-10-13 commit (Gen4+40) is kept only when the author is also in the treatment bucket verified.
  • The filter order is right after DropDuplicatesFilter verified.
  • We infer this is an experiment that splits viewers and authors together to measure the effect of ZeroFav channel impressions on the author side inferred. The evidence is the counters that count the author treatment and control buckets separately and the name codivert.

E. The Phoenix training code also changed. verified — phoenix/xrex/train/trainer_recsys.py:2349-2356, models/recsys_two_tower_model.py:556-618:

  • Two-tower retrieval supports num_microbatch > 1.
    • The candidate tower runs only once for all microbatches, and the users of each microbatch use the whole pool as in-batch negatives.
    • The loss is normalized by the number of valid users in the whole step.
    • This change increases the number of negatives with the same memory inferred. No two-tower preset in this diff uses num_microbatch > 1.
  • The following three other items are off by default.
    • The MoL gate CUDA kernel (mol_fused_gate, same formula)
    • A per-user ID list feature loader (top_p_, top_au_, latest_p_, and so on, with id_list_features="")
    • The attention output gate (attn_output_gate)
  • A proto RecentSearchQueries, which holds recent search queries and their embeddings, was also introduced, but no code uses it.

Why it matters

  • While the carousel is still off by default, the dedup and the conflict rule with other modules were settled as defaults first verified (values). We infer the order is to settle slot quality rules before turning the carousel on inferred. The evidence is that all five carousel-related changes since the 2026-10-08 commit (Gen4+38), namely +38, +40, +42, +43, and +44, dealt with internal rules of a carousel that is off by default.
  • PostEngagers is a feature that feeds "who reacted to this post" to the ranker as an ID list. What is new is that it passes the identities and action types of the engagers rather than aggregate counts verified (proto). Because it is always on in shadow traffic, we infer a model experiment is under way inferred.
